direct_claims: This chart shows the number of states involved in state-based conflicts over time.
The chart includes data from 1946 to 2024.
The data is categorized by region: Asia and Oceania, Middle East, Europe, Americas, and Africa.
The chart measures the number of states involved in interstate, intrastate, or extrasystemic conflicts.
A state is considered involved if it was a primary participant in at least one conflict that was ongoing that year.
The data source is Uppsala Conflict Data Program and Peace Research Institute Oslo (2025).
